name: forensic-analysis-skills-core
description: Análisis forense del repositorio Skills Core con calidad continua

scripts.verify:component-sizes: du -sh packages/*/src/ | sort -hr || echo 'Components not found in current directory'
scripts.count:skills: find skills/ -maxdepth 1 -type d | tail -n +2 | wc -l || echo 'Skills directory not found'
scripts.count:docs: find docs/ -name '*.md' | wc -l || echo 'Docs directory not found'
scripts.quality-gate: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test -- --passWithNoTests
scripts.quality-gate-full: npm run quality-gate && npm run validate-rules && npm run validate-evidence && npm run validate-completeness
scripts.quality-gate-dynamic: npm run quality-gate && npm run validate:dynamic-metrics && npm run validate:consistency && npm run validate:dynamic-compliance
scripts.quality-gate-strict: npm run quality-gate-full && npm run quality-gate-dynamic && echo '✅ All quality gates passed - Zero technical debt, Full dynamic compliance'
scripts.pre-commit: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check-encoding && npm run check-metrics
scripts.validate-all: npm run quality-gate-strict && npm run check-encoding && npm run check-metrics
scripts.quality-gate-ultimate: npm run quality-gate-dynamic && npm run validate:final && echo '✅ ULTIMATE QUALITY GATE PASSED - Zero violations, Full dynamic compliance, Production ready'
scripts.phase-a: npm run test:phase-a && npm run validate-evidence
scripts.phase-b: npm run test:phase-b && npm run validate-evidence
scripts.phase-c: npm run test:phase-c && npm run validate-evidence
scripts.phase-d: npm run test:phase-d && npm run validate-evidence
scripts.phase-e: npm run test:phase-e && npm run validate-evidence

author: Forensic Analysis Team
